5-best-compliance-ai-solutions-for-adver: Marketing teams are producing more content than ever, fuelled by the rapid adoption of generative AI. According to McKinsey, 71% of organisations now use generative AI in at least one function, with marketing and sales among the most active adopters. Adobe’s global study found 86% of creators now use AI in their workflows, from copy generation to image creation. But while creation has accelerated, compliance and sign off processes have not. Approval cycles still average 8+ days. 81% of marketers say compliance is a major barrier as content volume increases. In alcohol alone, the UK regulator found 4% of ads to be non-compliant or borderline. This mismatch between AI-accelerated production and manual, outdated approvals has created a new category: Creative Compliance AI - platforms that automate brand, legal, regulatory and responsible-marketing checks.
a-comparative-look-at-ai-chatbots-in-the: As air travel continues to rebound post-pandemic, airports are increasingly relying on AI chatbots to enhance operational efficiency and improve customer experiences. Travelers today expect quick, accurate, and personalized services, and AI chatbots have emerged as an indispensable tool for meeting these demands. In this comparative analysis, we explore how five of the world’s leading airports—Geneva, Lyon, Frankfurt, Singapore, and Taiwan—are leveraging AI chatbots to streamline operations and improve customer satisfaction.
acamar-films-voxly-digital-grow-reach-of:
Bing is a well loved and award-winning children’s brand across the world.

UK based Acamar Films, who produce Bing, wanted to leverage voice-technology and smart speakers as a new way to deliver their content to both little “Bingsters” and grown ups too.

Bing’s core audience is pre-schoolers who - despite being increasingly familiar with smart-speakers - lack the same vocal tones and clarity as adult users.
We needed to create an experience they wanted to interact with, without frustrating or disempowering them.
Alexa usage by families with young children is most prevalent from 3pm - 8pm. We needed to offer an experience which complemented and didn’t disrupt family routines.

A voice-driven experience for little ones who are just finding their voice. Powered with over 60 minutes of exclusive Bing content, ‘Bing Time’ brings together new scriptwriting, high production values and technical innovation to deliver exclusive audio stories, play-along games and a selection of Bing music and songs.

Designed with Bing’s young audience at its heart, the Skill responds to the rhythm of a child’s day; encouraging movement and active play during the morning and afternoon, while offering calmer bedtime stories and sleepy music in the early evening.
developing-a-conversational-ai-strategy-: Having launched one of the first Spirits and Cocktails AI Assistants in 2018 for Amazon Alexa, Diageo has a strong record of creating new ways for consumers to interact with their brands. In 2022, the Global Digital Innovation team were looking to establish a longer-term strategy for Voice Services. They wanted a partner to help them navigate the rapidly shifting landscape of Conversational AI and stay ahead of the curve. The Approach: We worked closely over several months with the Diageo Global Innovation team to develop a robust strategy and pilot roadmap to help them navigate the next 3 - 5 years of Conversational AI. Considering 4 x key areas of Voice (Search, Commerce, Media/Advertising & Experiences) this project pulled together: Stakeholder interviews and workshops; pulling together brands, data, legal, technical and innovation leads. User surveys and research. Competitor benchmarking. Platform & Technical reviews & forecasting. Voice Search Visibility Audit. Financial and Business Case. The Results: The final strategic output was an approved Global Strategy which included: Summary of key findings (internal & external). Strategic principles and market-entry points. A robust test and learn roadmap and number of prototypes. Clear recommendations for organisational & funding support to ensure success.
